correctness.rationale: For a general complex nine-plane, the corank-four skew locus is a smooth rank-six degeneracy threefold, with the deeper corank-six stratum absent (ambient codimension fifteen). The kernel-incidence projective bundle is an isomorphism here. Its 35-hyperplane transverse cut yields the exact virtual tangent Chern class. A nondegenerate six-dimensional alternating form forces the Plucker class to equal 3H and gives K=5H. Two exhaustive rational localization calculations over all 3150 fixed points give H^3=330, c1H^2=-1650, c2H=7920, c3=-31350; the neighboring size-eight computation reproduces genus 169. Riemann-Roch establishes the remaining numerical consequences. No extrapolation from samples is used.

value.rationale: The dimension-three degeneracy locus is intrinsic to the general rational Pfaffian quintic associated with a newly studied Calabi–Yau Grassmannian section. Its integral tangent Chern table determines the canonical volume 41250, topological Euler characteristic -31350, holomorphic Euler characteristic -1650 and numerical Hilbert polynomial. This provides a natural global quantitative profile of a smooth general-type singular stratum for birational and degeneration comparisons. It is not an arbitrary slice, textbook substitution, or merely the already-published degree: the c2 and c3 values are computed by a complete 3150-term equivariant localization.
